content:
sarah_partners: Quick sync — Datadog reached out and asked for a joint press blurb + a live demo on their KubeCon booth. They want: integrated tracing, a dashboard tile, and a 5–7 minute walk-through of how we monitor inference. They can amplify with social and a small paid placement. Thoughts?
mike_eng: sounds great. timeline?
sarah_partners: KubeCon demo day is in two weeks; PR embargo requested 5 days before the show.
anna_pm: tight window. do we have a stable sample app that surfaces OTLP traces + GPU metrics?
mike_eng: we have inference-demo v2 but it needs a small OTLP exporter tweak (add model and sequence metadata). I can do that today.
jess_ops: demo infra — can we run on staging dedicated pool or do we want a short-lived k8s cluster on partner infra?
sarah_partners: Datadog prefers we demo on our staging dedicated pool so they can validate traces end-to-end to their dashboard. OK with security?
jess_ops: ok but we'll keep API keys scoped and rotate after the event. No customer data.
oliver_docs: I'll prep the demo notes and a quickstart snippet for partners. Mike — can you paste the OTLP config you'd like in docs?
mike_eng: config snippet (for docs):
```
exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: "https://otlp.datadoghq.com:443"
    headers: { "DD-API-KEY": "<redacted>" }
resource_attributes:
  service.name: "redwood-inference-demo"
  telemetry.sdk.name: "redwood-otel"
attributes:
  model.name: "redwood-vicuna-7b"
```
sarah_partners: Datadog asked for two trace examples: cold-start end-to-end and cached-run (KV cache hit). They want to show the difference in waterfall & latency.
mike_eng: I'll record two trace captures and tag them. Will also include metrics to show GPU util + token throughput. Key metric names: infer.lat_ms, infer.tokens, cache.hit_ratio, gpu.utilization.
anna_pm: Datadog also requested a succinct joint quote for the announcement. Can we get a sentence from Matt (eng lead)? I'll draft and route for approval.
jess_ops: legal review on co-marketing is in progress — I pinged legal. Will update by EOD.
oliver_docs: question — should the dashboard tile use nvidia exporter or the runtime's aggregated metrics?
mike_eng: runtime aggregated metrics + nvidia-smi for host GPU view. Dashboard will include: trace waterfall, per-request latency heatmap, tokens/sec, and a cost-per-token gauge.
sarah_partners: marketing wants a 30–45s clip for social showing the trace waterfall -> dashboard -> inference latency/cost stat. Can we capture that?
anna_pm: yes, we'll capture once the demo is stable. Oliver — can you prepare the clip checklist?
oliver_docs: yes. I'll capture a short screenflow and provide a trimmed MP4. Also preparing a one-file reproducible demo (docker-compose + pre-captured traces).
mike_eng: for demo-only settings I'll flip sampling to 100% and enable verbose span attributes (demo cluster only).
sarah_partners: Datadog rep (eric_dd) asked whether we can surface cache hit ratio in traces and tag spans with model_name. Confirming that's fine?
mike_eng: yep — we'll add span attribute model.name and cache.hit boolean.
jess_ops: reminder: no PII or customer prompts. Use synthetic dataset only.
mike_eng: noted.
sarah_partners: timeline proposal: today — lock scope. +2d — infra + traces ready. +4d — docs, quote, clip draft. +6d — partner review & legal sign-off. +8d — embargo lift / press day.
anna_pm: assigning owners: mike_eng -> infra/traces/OTLP change; oliver_docs -> docs/demo sample + clip; anna_pm -> quote draft & partner liaison; jess_ops -> legal & infra gating; sarah_partners -> marketing ops & booth coordination.
mike_eng: I'll open branch `dd-demo-kubecon` and push PR with exporter change and sample traces.
sarah_partners: Datadog asked for a 30m dry-run before the show. Who can join?
mike_eng: I can.
anna_pm: me + sarah + oliver available as well.
jess_ops: I'll standby to troubleshoot infra during the dry-run.
oliver_docs: I'll upload the demo artifacts and the runbook to the demo bucket and share the link when done. Runbook will have a clear rollback step and key troubleshooting checks.
sarah_partners: one more: partner marketing wants a short co-branded slide (1–2 slides) that highlights integration points and observable signals. Oliver, can you draft a slide?
oliver_docs: yes, will draft and share for quick review.
sarah_partners: ok locking scope by EOD unless objections. Also pinging legal once quote draft is in. Thanks team :party_parrot:
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: branch dd-demo-kubecon -> demo-staging at 2021-07-15T14:32Z :rocket:
mike_eng: Deploy-bot says it all :eyes:
sarah_partners: closing loop — timeline ok? if so I'll lock scope and update the sheet.
anna_pm: lock it. :thumbsup:
